theme.rationale: For premium salon owners in India, the product must feel cinematic, high-end, and cutting-edge. Dark mode with fuchsia and gold accents establishes authority and elegance.

layout_sections.name: Header
layout_sections.style: Sticky Crystal Glass. backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with a 1px border-white/10 bottom edge. Links must be text-white/70 hover:text-white. Primary CTA on right.

layout_sections.name: Hero
layout_sections.style: Immersive and wide. A massive Playfair H1. The background must feature an AI-generated luxury salon image heavily masked with a radial dark gradient (bg-black/80 to bg-black/40) so the text remains highly readable.
components: H1: text-5xl md:text-7xl Playfair Display. Text: 'The Gold Standard for Modern Salons ✦'
Subtitle: text-lg md:text-xl Outfit text-neutral-400. 'Appointments, POS, CRM, and AI in one premium suite.'
CTA Group: Primary fuchsia button, Secondary outline button.
layout_sections.ai_image_prompt: Wide-angle photograph of a modern luxury salon interior, black and gold aesthetic, deep obsidian tones, subtle fuchsia neon underlighting, cinematic depth of field, high-end architectural photography, 16:9 aspect ratio.

layout_sections.name: Features
layout_sections.style: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A). Generous padding (p-8 to p-12). Cards have bg-white/5, backdrop-blur-md, border-white/10.

components.title: Mira AI ✦
components.ai_image_prompt: A sleek dark smartphone floating against a pitch black background, emitting a glowing fuchsia AI voice wave graphic and abstract geometric shapes, premium 3D render style, cinematic lighting.

components.title: Smart POS
components.ai_image_prompt: Minimalist black thermal receipt printer outputting a crisp white receipt, subtle gold glowing edge illumination, dark obsidian background, top-down cinematic angle.

layout_sections.name: Social Proof
layout_sections.style: Horizontal marquee or grid of elegant testimonial cards. Low contrast borders. Real Indian salon owner portraits.

layout_sections.name: Pricing
layout_sections.style: 3 columns. Middle column (Annual) must use the 'Tracing Beam' glow border effect (border-fuchsia-500/50 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(217,70,239,0.15)]).

layout_sections.name: Floating Widget
layout_sections.style: Ask Mira ✦. Must remain in bottom-right. Fuchsia gradient background, glowing drop shadow. Rounded-full.

layout_sections.name: Footer
layout_sections.style: py-24. Top border white/10. Include massive 'MIRACURL' text in Playfair Display (text-[10vw]) with gold ✦.

interaction_guidelines.hover_states: All buttons must lift (-translate-y-1) and gain a soft shadow on hover. Bento cards must slightly lighten (bg-white/10) on hover.
interaction_guidelines.animations: Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered fade-up on bento grid items. Stagger children by 0.1s.
interaction_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure text contrast over images. Use aria-hidden on purely decorative AI images. All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace the plain white layout with this Dark Luxe theme. 2. Implement the bento grid for features as specified. 3. Use the AI Image Prompts provided in the JSON to generate images using your AI image generation tool, and place them inside the hero and bento cards. 4. Maintain the floating 'Ask Mira ✦' widget. 5. Apply the specific typography (Playfair + Outfit).
